definitions.explanation: The basic substance from which something is made.
Material used as the basis for creative work or study.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{素材|そざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軽|かる}い。
{天然|てんねん}{素材|そざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{小説|しょうせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素材|そざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{集|あつ}める。
examples.english: To gather material for a novel.

notes:
{素材|そざい} refers to the basic substance or raw material from which something is made, or the source material for creative work.

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL MATERIAL:
- {天然|てんねん}{素材|そざい} (natural material)
- {合成|ごうせい}{素材|そざい} (synthetic material)
- {素材|そざい}がいい (good quality material)
- {素材|そざい}の{味|あじ}を{生|い}かす (bring out the natural flavor of ingredients)

SENSE 2 - SOURCE MATERIAL:
- {映画|えいが}の{素材|そざい} (material for a film)
- {作品|さくひん}の{素材|そざい} (subject matter for a work)
- {素材|そざい}を{集|あつ}める (gather material)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {材料|ざいりょう}: more concrete, refers to specific materials or ingredients used to make something
- {原料|げんりょう}: raw materials that undergo chemical transformation (e.g., oil for plastics)
- {素材|そざい}: emphasizes the inherent quality or potential of the material
